 This Mfa Is Filed Under Section 30(1) Of The
 Employees Compensation Act, 1923, Against The Judgment
 And Award Dated: 11.09.2018 Passed In Eca.No.101/2015, On
 The File Of The Principal Senior Civil Judge And Additional
 Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ranebennur, Partly
 Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation And Seeking
 Enhancement Of Compensation.

This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day, The
 Court Delivered The Following:
 -2-
 Nc: 2023:Khc-D:10605
 Mfa No. 104293 of 2018
 Judgment

The appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and Award dated 11.09.2018 passed in ECA No.101/2015 by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Ranebennur, seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The factum of accident, claimant sustaining injuries out of and in the course of employment as well as Insurance coverage are not disputed.

3. Heard the learned counsel from both sides and perused the records.
4.

The claimant has sustained the following injuries as per the evidence of the doctor:
i) Fracture of right medial malloelus bone.
ii) Fracture of right radius and ulna.
iii) Fracture of 7th and 8th ribs bones.

The doctor had stated that the claimant had suffered 40% of physical disability towards right hand and the Tribunal has taken only 13.33% as functional disability effecting earning capacity by making 1/3rd of the disability as assessed by the doctor.
The Commissioner has awarded a total compensation of Rs.1,80,541/- along with interest at the rate of 12% p.a., from the date of accident till the date of deposit.
The claimant is Driver by profession.
He has sustained fracture of the right hand and also to the ribs.
Assessment of functional disability always is not a mathematical or arithmetical calculation so as to make it as 1/3rd as stated by the doctor.

Therefore, considering the nature of injuries sustained, profession of the claimant and the disability sustained, it is just and N K Nagaraj S/O Shantappa @ ... vs Jagannath N.M. S/O Basappa on 14 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137773189/
2 proper to take 25% as permanent partial disability.

sentences.text: The accident is caused in the year 2015.
Therefore, monthly wage of Rs.8,000/- is taken into consideration.
As the claimant was aged 30 years, relevant factor applicable is 207.98.

Therefore, loss of earning capacity due to disability is reassessed as under:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:10605 Rs.8,000/- x 60/100 x 207.98 x 25/100 = Rs.2,49,576/-
6.
Further, the claimant is granted for a sum of Rs.39,150/- towards medical expenses and hospital charges.
Same is kept in tact.

7. Thus, the claimant is entitled for a total compensation of Rs.2,88,726/-
(Rs.2,49,576/- + Rs.39,150/-)
8.

For the reasons stated above, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii) The impugned judgment and award dated 11.09.2018 passed in ECA No.101/2015 by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Ranebennur is modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.1,08,185/- (Rs.2,88,726/- -
Rs.1,80,541/-) NC: 2023:KHC-D:10605 iii)
The claimant is entitled to interest at the rate of 12% per annum from the date of accident till the date of deposit.
iv) No order as to costs.
v) Registry to send back TCR to the learned Commissioner along with a copy of this Judgment.
vi) All other observations of the learned Commissioner are kept in tact.

SD/-
